name: Generic CMOS (default)
description: Built-in fallback technology. Maps (layer, datatype) pairs to a display name, RGB colour (0..1), and electrical role. role drives net connectivity: 'via' layers bridge other layers they overlap; 'poly'/'diffusion'/'conductor' connect to same-layer geometry they touch; 'nwell' carries no net but classifies a poly-over-diffusion gate as PMOS (inside) vs NMOS (outside) in H4; 'other' (the default) is inert cross-layer. Pairs not listed here fall back to a hash colour, a generated name, and role 'other'. Embedded at build time (include_str!); H9 will load tech files at runtime.
